annotations.title: How to get an NPI number

description: Answers "how do I get an NPI number", "how to apply for an NPI", "what do I need for an NPI", "what is an NPI", "NPI for a massage therapist / counselor / nurse / chiropractor / social worker". Returns the plain steps for getting an individual (Type 1) NPI: the free do-it-yourself path at nppes.cms.hhs.gov, the free SimpleNPI done-for-you path (usually within 10 minutes), what information is needed, the taxonomy code for the profession, and how long it takes. Call this first when someone asks how to get an NPI.

profession.description: Profession or license type, e.g. "Massage Therapist (LMT)", "LPC", "Nurse Practitioner". Optional; picks the taxonomy code.

state.description: Two-letter US state of the license, e.g. UT. Optional.
